steps.label: PACKAGED CONTENT
steps.sub: dashboards, reports, and semantic models from a workspace

steps.label: READ-ONLY FOR CONSUMERS
steps.sub: app users can't edit the content, only the workspace team can

steps.label: ONE APP PER WORKSPACE
steps.sub: the workspace is always the staging area behind it

caption: Name, description, logo, theme color, and contact information — the app's identity, separate from the workspace's own name.
Add content pulls specific items from the workspace into the app — publishing an app doesn't automatically expose everything in the workspace.

annotations.label: Nothing is included until you add it here

eyebrow: Not every user sees the same thing

steps.label: SEPARATE AUDIENCE GROUPS
steps.sub: each can show or hide different content from the same app

steps.label: GRANT ACCESS
steps.sub: to the entire organization, or to specific people/groups per audience

steps.label: ADVANCED PERMISSIONS
steps.sub: let an audience share or build on the underlying semantic models

caption: Each audience gets its own show/hide toggles per item — a Supplier Quality audience sees different content than Audience1, from the same underlying app.
Publish app requires a Power BI Pro or PPU license to create; recipients need one too, unless the content sits on Premium or Fabric F64+ capacity.

steps.label: HIDDEN ISN'T SECURED
steps.sub: a direct link still reaches hidden content unless you disable that

steps.label: RLS/OLS STILL APPLY
steps.sub: an app shares the underlying semantic model's security, it doesn't add any

steps.label: UPDATES DON'T AUTO-INCLUDE
steps.sub: newly added workspace content is hidden by default after an update
